title: The Elevator Mirror Shows FIVE 🛗
description:
Four of us got in the elevator. The mirror shows five faces. You get three floors to find the extra one.

Every face in the glass belongs to someone in the car. All but one.

It's made up. A creepy blocky puzzle, built with code and Blender.
